summary: MATHJØRNET ANS (org. no. 976 506 642) is a general partnership (ANS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-06-10. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 47.110 (Detaljhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Iraj Bordjlo Aghaei.
